settings.question: How fast do orders ship?
settings.answer:
Orders process within 24–48 hours and typically ship the next business day. No shipping on weekends or holidays.

Expedited orders placed before 12 PM Eastern ship the same business day. After 12 PM Eastern, or on a weekend, they go out the next business day.

settings.question: What does shipping cost?
settings.answer: Free on Continental US orders over $150. $9.95 flat rate under $150. Expedited and overnight are available at checkout.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes — we ship to 195 countries via FedEx International Connect Plus, and orders typically arrive within 7–14 business days. Duties and taxes are charged at checkout, so there's nothing extra to pay when your order arrives.

settings.question: My tracking says delivered but I don't have the package
settings.answer:
Once tracking shows delivered to your address, the order is considered fulfilled. In an apartment or multi-unit building, check with building staff or the shared mail area first — that's where most of them turn up.

Still missing? Contact us with your order number and we'll help you sort out next steps.

settings.question: What's the difference between Open Sole and Closed Sole?
settings.answer:
Open Sole: Heel exposed, mid-foot breathing hole. More grounded, barefoot feel. Natural toe splay.

Closed Sole: Heel and foot fully covered.

Both perform identically — same grip, same stability, same studio uses. The choice is preference and feel only. Both are $74.

settings.question: Which style is better for reformer?
settings.answer: Either. Both soles perform identically across barre, Pilates, Lagree, reformer, and Megaformer — same grip, same stability. Pick by feel: grounded and barefoot (Open) or full coverage (Closed).

settings.question: Do they really not slip?
settings.answer:
360° all-over grip — not dots, not patches. It covers the entire sole, heel, and edges, so you stay locked in through holds, transitions, and balance work.

No sliding. No resets.

settings.question: What workouts are they designed for?
settings.answer:
Built for studio training: barre, Pilates, Lagree, reformer, Megaformer, and yoga.

Also great for weight lifting, outdoor volleyball, martial arts, barefoot running, boating, paddleboarding, outdoor yoga, beach, and resortwear — anywhere you'd go barefoot.

settings.question: Will they make my feet hot or sweaty?
settings.answer:
The opposite, in most cases. The open-toe design and lightweight material let air circulate, so they stay cooler than grip socks that wrap the whole foot.

For hot yoga specifically, a thin full sock works like a towel — it absorbs the extra sweat without affecting grip.

settings.question: What surfaces do they work on?
settings.answer:
All standard studio surfaces — reformer carriages, Megaformer platforms, wood floors, rubber mats, and yoga mats. Outdoors they hold on sand, boat decks, and paddleboards.

One caution: certain wet tile and stone areas are inherently slippery for any footwear.

settings.question: Can I wear them barefoot or with a sock?
settings.answer:
Either way works. Many people prefer the barefoot feel and the direct connection to the surface. Others like a thin toeless or individual-toe sock for warmth or moisture control.

Skip thick or full-toe socks — they reduce the natural toe splay that makes these work.

settings.question: What are Performance Skins made of?
settings.answer:
A proprietary grip material — skin-safe and non-toxic, with no latex and no silicone. Made in the USA.

The surface is non-porous, so sweat sits on it rather than soaking in the way it does with fabric.

settings.question: Why $74 when grip socks are $20?
settings.answer:
Because you buy them once. Grip socks run $18–28 a pair and lose their grip after six to eight washes, so most people go through 8–12 pairs a year — $144 to $336, every year.

Barreletics is $74 once, with the same performance on class 1 as on class 1,000. Buy 2 or more and save 10% with code SAVE2, applied at checkout. Shop Pay splits a pair into 4 interest-free payments of $18.50.

settings.question: How should my Performance Skins fit?
settings.answer:
Feet are different, so this varies. Generally they should feel secure — not pinching, and not sliding around on your foot.

The material stretches and conforms to your foot, so depending on your foot shape and width that can feel close and snug or more relaxed. Both are fine. There's no break-in period — how they feel on day one is how they feel.

To place them: the ball of your foot sits where your foot meets your toes, then gently tug the top edge at the ankle.

settings.question: What size should I get?
settings.answer:
Medium fits women's US 5.5–7.5. Large fits women's US 8–11, and men up to 10.5.

There is no small size. If you'd like a personal recommendation before ordering, send us your usual shoe size and we'll tell you which to take. Full detail on the size chart.

settings.question: What if I'm between sizes?
settings.answer:
Width decides — don't just round up.

If you're a wide foot at 7 or 7.5, size up to Large. If you're a narrow 8, size down to Medium. At 8.5 and above, stay in Large — you need the length, regardless of width.

Color helps fine-tune. Black and Light Grey are the most forgiving for wider feet. Dark Grey, Hot Coral, and Blue run slightly snugger.

settings.question: Do certain colors fit differently?
settings.answer: Slightly. Dark Grey, Hot Coral, and Blue run a little snugger. Black and Light Grey are the most forgiving, especially for wider feet.

settings.question: Mine feel too tight — or too loose
settings.answer:
Too tight, or pressure on your toes: the size is likely too small. Move up one size.

Too loose, or shifting as you move: likely too large. Move down one size. If you're already in Medium, a thin sock underneath gives you a snugger fit without affecting grip.

A size exchange is free and usually faster than a refund.

settings.question: I have narrow feet — any tips?
settings.answer:
If you're a narrow 8, take the Medium. And consider Dark Grey, Hot Coral, or Blue — they run snugger than Black or Light Grey.

Plenty of customers with narrow feet also wear a thin toeless or individual-toe sock underneath for extra security. You keep full grip either way.

settings.question: How do I clean my Performance Skins?
settings.answer: Hand wash with warm soapy water. That's it.

settings.question: How long do they take to dry?
settings.answer: Hand wash with warm soapy water. That's it.

settings.question: How should I put them on and take them off?
settings.answer: Pull from the top of the foot, not the straps. Pulling the straps puts stress on the attachment points and shortens the life of the pair.

settings.question: How long do Performance Skins last?
settings.answer:
Many customers use the same pair for years — some wear them 6+ days a week for over three years with zero issues. Built in the USA.

That's the real difference from a grip sock. Silicone dots are printed onto fabric and wear off after six to eight washes.

settings.question: Will the grip wear off over time?
settings.answer:
No. The grip is injection-molded into the sole itself, so there is nothing to peel, flake, or separate — unlike silicone dots printed onto fabric.

The same performance on class 1 as on class 1,000.

settings.question: Do they lose shape after many uses?
settings.answer: No. The structured, injection-molded sole holds its shape — it doesn't stretch out the way fabric grip socks do.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer:
Returns and exchanges within 30 days of delivery. Try them on indoors for fit — like any shoe. Items must be clean and like new. Items worn for a workout, class, or outdoors aren’t eligible.

Start in the returns portal. US return shipping is $7.95 flat (deducted from the refund). Full detail on Returns & exchanges.

settings.question: Can I exchange for a different size?
settings.answer: Yes — and size exchanges are free to ship once we receive and inspect your return. Start an exchange in the returns portal within 30 days. Same eligibility: clean, like new, not worn for a workout, class, or outdoors.

settings.question: What does the warranty cover?
settings.answer:
Every pair is backed against manufacturing defects for 90 days (for example grip separation, strap detachment, or material failure from a defect). Normal wear and tear, accidental damage, and damage from use or improper care aren’t covered.

Return of the defective item usually isn’t required — reach out and we’ll take care of it. Full detail on 90-day warranty.

settings.question: How do international warranty claims work?
settings.answer: Send us a photo of the defect. If it’s approved, the customer covers shipping and duties on the replacement — no need to ship the original pair back internationally.

settings.title: Get in touch.
settings.body: Sizing, orders, or claims — contact us with your order number and we'll get back within 24–48 hours.
